backlog.title: Implement user recommendation feedback collection
backlog.action: Capture relevant, not relevant, clicked, applied and dismissed events.
acceptance_criteria: Feedback events are recorded with request_id
Feedback is associated with student_id and job_id
Feedback data can be queried for model evaluation

backlog.title: Build production relevance evaluation dataset
backlog.action: Create a labelled dataset from genuine post-launch interaction feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Real user feedback is linked to predictions
Online relevance metrics can be calculated reproducibly

backlog.title: Review low-score recommendation handling
backlog.action: Review ranking thresholds and presentation of low-confidence recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Low-confidence recommendations have an appropriate user-facing treatment

backlog.title: Increase post-launch evaluation sample size
backlog.action: Continue collecting production-safe interaction logs and define minimum sample thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Minimum evaluation sample threshold is documented
Automated health decisions require sufficient observations
